question: SOMR is related to KGEJ in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, MIGL is related to EAYD. To which of the following options is OKIN related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/616212e0308a593f26d475848e5e0800eb77e3b6b62a8883f182b3a746bb4159.png] 

The pattern followed here is

SOMR - KGEJ**
S - 8 = K

O - 8 = G

M - 8 = E

R - 8 = J

MIGL - EAYD

M - 8 = E

I - 8 = A

G - 8 = Y

L - 8 = D

Similarly,

OKIN - ?

O - 8 = G

K - 8 = C

I - 8 = A

N - 8 = F

OKIN related GCAF.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"**
